The best match is [1], which improves detailed image captioning by using one shared vision-language model to act as the caption policy, rubric generator, and rubric judge. [1] It builds rubrics online from sampled captions and image evidence, and it uses an exponential moving average of the policy parameters to update a shared momentum model for the generator and judge, so the rubric roles track policy updates smoothly. [1]

The closest related paper is [2], but it focuses on evaluating image descriptions by separating specificity from length rather than on generating and checking rubric-based captions with a shared moving-average model. [2]
